PreInvocation.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event SessionStart; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SessionStart; fi

PostInvocation.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event Stop; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook Stop; fi
